faq.q: How soon can we get started?
faq.a: Most projects kick off within 2-3 business days of finalising your plan — we'll share a clear timeline before we begin.

faq.q: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
faq.a: No. Our plans are billed monthly and you can upgrade, downgrade or stop anytime — no long lock-ins.

faq.q: Can I mix services from different plans?
faq.a: Yes. The bundled plans are a starting point — tell us what your business needs and we'll customise a package for you.

faq.q: Will I get reports on my campaigns?
faq.a: Yes, you'll get regular performance updates so you always know what's working and where your budget is going.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside India?
faq.a: Yes, we work with clients across locations — most communication happens over WhatsApp, call or email.

faq.q: What if I only need one service, not a full plan?
faq.a: That's fine — every service on our Services page can be booked individually at the listed price.
